svg.text: Black. The brand timecode ruler draws across the top. One card lands centre: FIND AN
EDITOR, status "searching…". A cursor clicks it.
Ruler wipes L→R (e-out, 400ms). Card drops 22px and settles with overshoot. Cursor
Room tone, a single trackpad click, keyboard tick.
Card flips to reveal the next card behind it; the loop starts.
Six cards form a ring: Find an editor → Send the brief → Wait → Review → Request
Cards deal in clockwise, 40ms stagger. The dashed orbit starts rotating slowly; a
highlight steps card to card like a clock hand.
Each card = soft paper tick, rising pitch.
Ring accelerates; cards duplicate off the orbit.

g.text: can we try a different font?

svg.text: The loop multiplies: cards overlap, messages and files pile in ("any update on the
Speed ramp up. Cards spawn with motion blur and random 4–12° tilt; camera drifts and
"Making fifty — week after week — is another story."
Overlapping notifications, Slack pings, error blip, keyboard flurry building.
Hard freeze on a single frame.

g.text: can we try a different font?

svg.text: Everything stops mid-air and drains to grey. Only the timecode stays lit, held on one
Hard freeze (0 frames ease). Desaturate over 6 frames. A thin scan line passes once.
All sound cuts dead. 600ms of silence; the loudest moment in the film.
Green corner brackets enter from the edges of frame.
